rows.grounds: fused pronoun etat plus numeral sapta
compound of numeral ekaviṃśati and participle saṃyuta

items.question: What total number of earths is proclaimed when the sevenfold set is joined with twenty-one?
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'this seven' depends on the preceding verse.
items.plain_english: This seven is proclaimed, joined with twenty-one.
